1.title: Download Content
1.message: The download module lets you fetch videos, audios and images from many internet platforms at the best available quality.
1.mensaje: The download module lets you fetch videos, audios and images from many internet platforms at the best available quality.
steps: Select 'Download content' in the main menu
Pick the content type: Video, Audio or Image
Paste the full URL of the content you want
Pick the quality from the available options
Wait for the download to finish
Find your file in the matching folder

tips: Videos: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and more are supported
Audio: downloads as MP3 with cover and metadata included
Images: original quality is always preserved
Downloads are saved into auto-organized folders
If a download fails, check that the URL is correct and public
Keep yt-dlp updated: pip install -U yt-dlp

2.title: Convert Files
2.message: The converter lets you transcode your media files to different formats while keeping the best possible quality and preserving metadata.
2.mensaje: The converter lets you transcode your media files to different formats while keeping the best possible quality and preserving metadata.
steps: Select 'Convert files' in the main menu
Pick the conversion type you need
Enter the file name (no full path needed)
The system will search for the file on your device
Pick the desired output format
Wait for the conversion to finish
Choose whether to keep or delete the original file

tips: Videos: MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WebM available
Audio: MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, OGG, M4A with cover preserved
Images: PNG, JPG, WebP, BMP, GIF, TIFF, ICO supported
Video → Audio: extract audio keeping the video cover
Conversion preserves metadata when possible
Lossless formats like FLAC and PNG keep max quality
OGG and other advanced formats require cover conversion

3.title: Enhance Quality
3.message: The enhancement module lets you boost resolution and quality of your files with advanced processing techniques.
3.mensaje: The enhancement module lets you boost resolution and quality of your files with advanced processing techniques.
steps: Select 'Enhance quality' in the main menu
Pick the file type: Video, Audio or Image
Enter the name of the file to enhance
Pick the desired enhancement level
The process may take a while depending on the file
Review the result and compare it with the original
Choose whether to keep or delete the original file
pasos: Select 'Enhance quality' in the main menu
Pick the file type: Video, Audio or Image
Enter the name of the file to enhance
Pick the desired enhancement level
The process may take a while depending on the file
Review the result and compare it with the original
Choose whether to keep or delete the original file
tips: Videos: upscaling up to 4K with high-quality Lanczos
Audio: bitrate boost up to 320kbps preserving cover
Images: up to ×2.0 scaling with sharpness/contrast filters
Enhancement is intensive, be patient
Higher quality = bigger file size
Recommended: 'Balanced' level for best results
Small videos (360p, 480p) benefit most from upscaling
Audio cannot improve beyond its original quality

4.title: YouTube Search
4.message: The search prototype lets you find YouTube videos without leaving the app, then download them as video or audio.
4.mensaje: The search prototype lets you find YouTube videos without leaving the app, then download them as video or audio.
steps: Select 'Search YouTube' in the main menu
Type your search query and press Enter
Pick a result from the list (0 cancels)
Choose video or audio download
Pick the quality and wait for it to finish

tips: Prototype: shows the top 8 results via yt-dlp ytsearch
Use specific queries for better matches
0 / q / cancel goes back without downloading
